scope: Controlled application integration check; existing changeAppearance, restoreProject and saveLocal functions executed unmodified from src/app.js. No browser or full regression run.
controlledDependencies: studio.setAppearance rejects once with controlled image decode failure
DOM rendering and toast are no-ops; showError records errors
steps: Start with createDefaultProject(), busy=false and appearanceTask=Promise.resolve(true).
Run changeAppearance to set background.color=#123456; inject setAppearance rejection and await the operation.
Confirm operation returned false, background rolled back to #000000, then call saveLocal and inspect stored JSON.
Restore a fresh valid project with background.color=#654321 using restoreProject.
Call saveLocal again and inspect the second stored JSON.
